notes.blurb: Dry-country cut stone. Flat roofs used as floors, parapets, deep reveals, everything stepping up the hill in terraces.
notes.construction: solid masonry, openings small and deeply recessed, parapets above every roof, timber only for shade structures; the shade is spruce
notes.ground: terraced hard, retaining walls doubling as the walls of the storey below; the ground between the buildings is cut and dressed, not planted
notes.roofs: flat with a parapet; one loggia or awning per building in timber
notes.signature: an external stair climbing the outside of the building to its roof
